legacy_root.answer: On this worktree the A2 generator analogue (command-center/p2-wave/probes/ARC-0010/generator.py) was measured at 96 workflows / 48 protocol-docs / 64 presets / 1 skill(s). Live 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.json and 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.json are absent, so these timings are the prototype analogue. A2 has no protocol kind; protocols were extra doc files so the write-count still includes them. Full regeneration writes 216 files (formula 7+skills+protocol_docs+workflows+presets = 216). Median full pipeline is 0.091648s (3 runs, spread 0.0620); jsonschema validate is 0.070782s of that. A one-field change writes 2 files (entry + embedding catalog). Incremental skip-validate 0.001860s; with full validate 0.072715s. Half catalogue (112 files) full pipeline 0.047603s; two-point slope 0.00042351050000031767 s/file. No commit-hook budget exists in-tree; a STATED 2.0s pre-commit comfort line is the comparison, not an owner policy. Crossover reached at target: False. Linear FIT of file count at 2.0s: 4722.032549366224 (FIT, not measured). Probe2 (bash -lc, monotonic, preset quorum) agreed.

crossover.budget_source: No commit-hook timeout is in this worktree. 2.0s is a stated interactive pre-commit comfort threshold, not measured owner policy.
crossover.recommendation: Keep full regeneration on every commit at the measured 96/48/64 analogue. Incremental render+write wins on file-write count (2 vs 216) but not on wall-clock unless jsonschema validate is cached. FIT to the stated 2.0s line is 4722.032549366224 files.
